payout_quote: Those who qualify will receive up to $4,500 in compensation for time and participation... $200 - Screening visits; $200 - Baseline visit; Up to $2,700 - Inpatient stay; $600 - Outpatient visit; $750 - Completion bonus; $50 - Follow-up phone call (day 50 of study); Up to $100 travel reimbursement per on-site visit.
steps: Open the official Clinilabs study page (clinilabs.com, 'Inpatient Opioid Use Disorder') and confirm you meet the stated criteria: age 18-65 and currently receiving (or willing to begin) treatment for opioid use disorder.
Contact Clinilabs to pre-qualify and complete the on-site pre-qualification testing (ECG, urinalysis, bloodwork).
Attend 1 screening visit ($200) and 1 baseline visit ($200) and pass medical screening.
Remain in the clinic for the up-to-7-day inpatient stay in Eatontown, NJ (up to $2,700).
Complete the outpatient follow-up visit ($600), the follow-up phone call ($50), and stay through the completion bonus ($750) plus up to $100 travel reimbursement per on-site visit.
catches: Study-specific patient population: only adults 18-65 with opioid use disorder who are currently receiving or willing to begin treatment qualify; you must pass medical screening, and not everyone qualifies.
The $4,500 is an 'up to' ceiling paid per completed visit/component; partial completion pays partial amounts.
Heavy commitment: up to 7 days inpatient with no smoking and no outside visitors, plus a study duration of up to 240 days.
You receive an investigational medication designed to treat opioid withdrawal symptoms, with real medical risks and side effects.
Travel reimbursement is capped at $100 per on-site visit and depends on completing visits.
biggest_catch: This is a 7-day inpatient study for adults with opioid use disorder testing an investigational withdrawal medication - you must pass strict medical screening, live in the clinic with no visitors, and the $4,500 ceiling is only paid for completing every visit and component.
eligibility: Adults 18-65 currently receiving treatment for opioid use disorder or willing to begin treatment; must pass on-site pre-qualification (ECG, urinalysis, bloodwork); additional criteria apply.
timing: Compensation is paid per completed visit/component ($200 screening, $200 baseline, up to $2,700 inpatient stay, $600 outpatient visit, $750 completion bonus, $50 phone follow-up) plus up to $100 travel reimbursement per on-site visit; study may last up to 240 days.
